description:
FOUND (s526w1, YAML-Tiny t/11_read_string.t subtest "invalid UTF-8": "open(t/data/latin1.yml) failed: No such file or directory at t/lib/TestUtils.pm line 45" -- the line is `open( FILE, " $file" )`).
Probe (scratch p-open2.pl): `open(FILE, " /etc/hostname") or die "fail: $!"` and `open(G, "/etc/hostname ")` -- perl opens both (2-arg open trims leading and trailing whitespace of the name, perlfunc open); PCL dies "fail: No such file or directory".
Rows: YAML-Tiny 11_read_string.t *PLAN* + row 4.  Layer: cl/ runtime, the 2-arg open mode/name parser.
subject: Two-argument open does not strip WHITESPACE around the filename: `open(FILE, " $file")` fails ENOENT where perl opens $file (YAML-Tiny t/lib/TestUtils.pm slurp)
